meaning:
1) rest, quietness
1a) quietness, quiet attitude
1b) rest (of death)

renderings.kjv: and that which should be set

elsewhere.note: Yes, he would have allured you out of distress, into a wide place, where there is no restriction. That which is set on your table would be full of fatness.
If a wise man goes to court with a foolish man, the fool rages or scoffs, and there is no peace.
Better is a handful, with quietness, than two handfuls with labor and chasing after wind.
